copy.aboutSubheading: The roots of the lotus go deep into the Self. Through the roots, the channels we call nadis, we experience the eternal sound: nadam.
copy.aboutDescription: In a world focused on doing, on productivity and on taking sides, we lose the ability to inhabit the body. Once you are at peace, at home in yourself, you can care for others and support your community. In 2027 the Jivamukti Yoga Tribe Gathering brings the tribe to Luxembourg to practice this together.

about.title: About the Tribe | Jivamukti Yoga Tribe Gathering 2027
about.description: What the Jivamukti Yoga Tribe Gathering is, and the theme of the Luxembourg Lotus edition: Nada Through Nadis.
about.quote: "Hurry home to your real home, which is OM"
about.intro: The Tribe Gathering is the Jivamukti Yoga community meeting in one place to practice, listen and sing together: a satsang, the company of like-minded people in pursuit of the truth. In 2027 the tribe gathers in Luxembourg under the theme Nada Through Nadis.
about.themeLine: THE ROOTS OF THE LOTUS GO DEEP INTO THE SELF. THROUGH THE ROOTS, THE CHANNELS WE CALL NADIS, WE EXPERIENCE THE ETERNAL SOUND: NADAM.
